anabaena.translation: n. 淡水藻类的一种, 项圈藻

anabantidae.definition: n. small freshwater spiny-finned fishes of Africa and southern Asia

anabaptism.definition: n. a Protestant movement in the 16th century that believed in the primacy of the Bible, baptised only believers, not infants, and believed in complete separation of church and state

anabaptists.definition:
plural of anabaptist
n. adherent of Anabaptism
anabaptists.translation: (anabaptist 的复数) n. 再洗礼派教徒

anabas.definition: n the type genus of the family Anabantidae; small fish that resemble perch

anabasine.translation: 假木贼碱, 新烟碱, 天虫碱, 安纳巴松

anabasine sulfate.translation: [医] 硫酸假木贼硷, 硫酸新烟硷

anabasis.definition:
n. A journey or expedition up from the coast, like that of
   the younger Cyrus into Central Asia, described by Xenophon in his work
   called "The Anabasis."
n. The first period, or increase, of a disease;
   augmentation.
anabasis.translation:
n. 进军, 远征
[医] 假木贼属

anabasis aphylla.translation: [医] 无叶猬藜, 无叶毒藜(有效成分为新烟硷)

anabatic.definition: a. of an air current or wind; rising especially up a slope
anabatic.translation:
a. 上升的
[医] 加剧的, 加重的

anabena.translation: [医] 太湖念珠藻属(蓝绿藻之一属,使水污臭)

anabiosis.definition: n. suspended animation in organisms during periods of extreme drought from which they revive when moisture returns
anabiosis.translation:
n. 失水休眠, 回生
[医] 回生, 苏生

anabiotic.definition: a of or related to the state of anabiosis

anable.translation: [人名] 安纳布尔，安娜布尔（女名）

anabole.translation: 回上, 反胃, 呕吐

anabolergy.translation: [医] 组成代谢力, 同化力

anabolic.definition:
a. of or related to the synthetic phase of metabolism
a. characterized by or promoting constructive metabolism
anabolic.translation:
a. 合成代谢的
[医] 组成代谢的, 同化的

anabolics.translation: adj. 合成代谢的；同化的

anabolin.translation: 合成代谢产物, 同化产物

anabolism.definition: n. the synthesis in living organisms of more complex substances (e.g., living tissue) from simpler ones together with the storage of energy
anabolism.translation:
n. 合成代谢
[化] 合成代谢

anabolite.translation: [医] 组成代谢产物, 同化产物

anabrus simplex.translation: [网络] 摩门螽斯；摩门螽蟖
